C1.result: Actual MLX runs for both pinned models and live Kaggle vLLM; llama.cpp transport contracts; native Claude adapter exercised through logged B0 and M with mocked Messages responses. No paid API call required.

C2.result: Both models completed 100 identical cases, 20 per project-schema task. All 200 raw scores reproduce. Selected mlx-community/Qwen3-8B-4bit by the rule fixed before the runs.

C3.result: All six read-only tools validate arguments/results, cutoff and the 12-call budget. Asserted strength/evidence changes require the matching verified proof; demotion and rejected reverification clear stale approval.

C4.result: Shared state tracks unresolved edges, searches and remaining budget; shallow-first deterministic priority; stops on resolution, two searches adding nothing, or exhausted budget.

C5.result: One Pipeline.run and SETTINGS flags for B0, B1, B1-R, B2, A-NoVerify, A-NoLoop and M. All seven exercised locally in fixtures and in the 14-graph live vLLM run.

C6.result: Prompts, completions, actual tokens, latency, typed calls/results, state and stop/error records. Claude backend schema repaired and JSON schemas regenerated. Receipts bind successful logs to graph artifacts.

C7.result: UER, strength inflation, reference-edge recall, provenance accuracy and strict path validity at hop 1/2/3+ and overall. Missing denominators remain null; independent support/reference gates remain enforced.

C8.result: Seeded paired-query resampling with 95% intervals for only B1 deep-minus-shallow and M-minus-B1 overall. Missing pairs and nonfinite data are handled explicitly.

C9.result: 40 synthetic states with expected actions; 20/20 freshly executed fault cases. Archived model action scores independently recomputed as 5/40 correct, 34/40 schema/cutoff valid; this is not model-led recovery or human research gold.

C10.result: Selected pinned model generated all 25 responses. Complete response-bound assistant review: advice 0/25, own forecast 0/25, post-date evidence 0/25, asserted without span 0/25.

C11.result: Private two-T4 vLLM run at source 245e0fd completed 14/14 graphs, full remote/local audit and all 14 cached on unchanged resume. Measured allocation including setup: 1.211103 GPU-hours, below the two-hour limit.
